description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 - Order under Sub Section (1) of Section 46
reasoning: This gazette notification imposes an annual levy on electricity licensees under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It constitutes a regulatory action by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka, establishing compliance requirements and financial obligations for licensees. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
